programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Singaporean cuisine is widely influenced by several ethnic groups that make up the population. programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: There are approximately 350 types of pasta in Italy! Pasta shapes are designed to hold the sauce in the best way possible due to form and consistency. In this episode we’ll be pairing pasta with some of my favourite sauces and salads, and learning how to make maccheroni al ferro by hand!

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: An episode to make the kids happy, learn to make nutty chocolate pops, a luscious chocolate and meringue cake, ice cream with a Lamington twist or caramel filled choc nut cups - the options are endless.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: One home cook attempts to make a crowd-pleasing dish that’s nutritious and delicious, and the Wall of Chefs kitchen explodes with culture in the Chef’s Fridge round, which features staple ingredients from famed Japanese/Italian Chef Joël Watanabe.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Host Sarah Sharratt is invited by her local mayor to accompany him on a seasonal pigeon hunt; a tradition that dates back hundreds of years in the region. The hunters inpire Sarah to throw a dinner party featuring stuffed pigeon on roasted fennel and pommes dauphinoise (potato gratin). For dessert Sarah makes an apple tresse with armagnac, another traditional ingredient she sources from a famous local producer.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie’s cooking up his colorful Chickpea and Chard Pork, a hearty one pan wonder that’s perfect to rustle up at the end of a busy day. Next, a brilliant little recipe for egg fried rice, a fast food favorite, and a super-speedy veggie supper.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Something as simple as a family picnic has an elegance in France. Host Sarah Sharratt's picnic menu consists of egg and cheese filo tarts, spaghetti frittata and strawberry cobblers cooked in little jam jars. Sarah visits a goat cheese maker in the famous cliffside village of Rocamadour, and helps with a strawberry harvest in a local greenhouse. The entire family, unruly dogs included, head off for the picnic where Sarah tries to convince everyone that a baby goat should be in their future.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson
programme.desc: Fruit mousses are a staple in patisseries, and come in all sorts of colours and shapes. They can be a dessert on their own or part of a grand torte.

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
programme.sub-title: Jamies Easy MealsFor Everyday - CHEAT’S FISH AND CHIPS
programme.desc: Taking the nation’s favorite takeaway, fish and chips, Jamie gives it a homemade makeover that’s healthier and super tasty. Plus, he takes two of our favorite ingredients, sausage and mash, and creates a pie like you’ve never seen before.

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
programme.sub-title: Jamies Easy MealsFor Everyday - MY KINDA BUTTER CHICKEN
programme.desc: Jamie rustles up a family-friendly version of a delicious butter chicken that even his little ones give the thumbs up to and shows a super-simple salmon en croute that’s so easy it will become a real midweek winner.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s Nottingham show kicks off at The Plough, where front of house manager Becky and chef Mark are aiming to showcase their gastro pub grub. Our hosts have their work cut out to impress competitive duo Antony and James from French Restaurant Paris and Kyme and Gemma from rival pub, The Red Lion. It’s not long before Antony’s views on chivalry ruffles feathers with the girls and when the gang get arty, Gemma is less than impressed with James’ abstract offering.
